argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.W.7.1: Introduce claims, acknowledge opposing claims, organize logical reasons/evidence, use accurate credible sources, connect claims/reasons/evidence, maintain formal style and conclude.
argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.7.1: Use phrases and clauses, purposeful sentence types and correctly placed modifiers.
argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.7.2: Use commas between coordinate adjectives and correct spelling/capitalization.
argumentative.CCSS.ELA-Literacy.L.7.3: Choose precise concise language and remove redundancy.
